mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_like ul WHERE ul.target_type = 'comment' AND ul.target_id = c.id AND ul.status = 1 AND ul.deleted = 0) AS like_count, b.title as blogTitle FROM tb_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_blog b ON c.blog_id = b.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_comment WHERE blog_id = #{blogId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
